response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), o AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS v FROM Products), k1 AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.a FROM t, o WHERE t.a > o.v), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.production_type_code, k1.a FROM k1, m WHERE k1.a > m.v) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS avg_type_price, AVG(k2.a - o.v) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(k2.a - m.v) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM k2, o, m
